# Zoé — components & tools (generated)

## <z-element> (core)
The living base: carries interaction states as :state() and emits z-state.
Attributes: current (boolean), loading (boolean), disabled (boolean), error (boolean), success (boolean), name (string), required (boolean), state (string)
Events: z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success

## <z-layer> (core)
The pieces of a component — its background, its label, its tick — already painted for you. You only write a layer to take over one precise part.
Attributes: part (string)
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success

## <z-contact> (tools)
Need a click effect across your whole page? Drop this tag anywhere — problem solved. Two effects by default; not to your taste? Make your own in a few lines of CSS.
Attributes: fx (string), disabled (boolean), size (string), width (string), duration (string), color (string)
Events: zoe:contact

## <z-cursor> (tools)
The pointer's wake: one flat tag, and the mouse leaves a ribbon behind it.
Attributes: fx (string), tone (string), size (string)
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success

## <z-checkbox> (components)
A checkbox — inherits all z-element states, marker + label anatomy, painted by the skin.
Attributes: current (boolean), indeterminate (boolean), name (string), value (string), required (boolean), disabled (boolean), error (boolean), success (boolean)
Events: change, z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success, indeterminate

## <z-button> (components)
A button — inherits all z-element states, skinnable by themes.
Attributes: type ("submit" | "reset" | "button"), disabled (boolean), loading (boolean), error (boolean), success (boolean)
Events: z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success

## <z-radio> (components)
A radio button — z-element states, marker + label anatomy, selects but never unselects itself.
Attributes: value (string), current (boolean), disabled (boolean), error (boolean), success (boolean)
Events: change, z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success

## <z-radio-group> (components)
A group of z-radio: single choice, arrow-key navigation, roving tabindex, one value.
Attributes: value (string), disabled (boolean), error (boolean), success (boolean)
Events: change, z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success

## <z-slider> (components)
A value slider — poses progress (0→1) in the cascade, the skin paints everything.
Attributes: value (number), min (number), max (number), step (number), orientation ('horizontal' | 'vertical'), markers (boolean | number), label ('over' | 'under' | 'none'), disabled (boolean)
Events: input, change, z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success

## <z-badge> (components)
A status/count pill — inherits z-element's tone & size variants, painted by the skin. Almost zero code: the frozen socle does the work.
Attributes: tone ("main" | "complement" | "soft" | "success" | "danger"), size ("xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl")
Events: z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success

## <z-tag> (components)
A tag/chip for keywords, filters, categories — inherits tone & size; optionally removable.
Attributes: removable (boolean), tone ("main" | "complement" | "soft" | "success" | "danger"), size ("xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl")
Events: zoe:remove, z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success

## <z-switch> (components)
An on/off switch — inherits all z-element states, form-bound, painted by the skin. Immediate effect, unlike a checkbox you'll validate later.
Attributes: current (boolean), name (string), value (string), disabled (boolean)
Events: change, z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success

## <z-progress> (components)
A progress bar — inherits z-element states + tone/size, painted by the skin. value/max → a percentage the CSS draws.
Attributes: value (number), max (number), indeterminate (boolean), tone ("main" | "complement" | "soft" | "success" | "danger"), size ("xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl")
Events: z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success, indeterminate

## <z-spinner> (components)
A loading spinner — inherits tone/size, role=status with an accessible label. The ring spins in CSS.
Attributes: label (string), tone ("main" | "complement" | "soft" | "success" | "danger"), size ("xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl")
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success

## <z-avatar> (components)
An identity chip — an image if given, otherwise the initials. role=img with an alt from name. Inherits tone/size.
Attributes: src (url), name (string), size ("xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl")
Events: z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success

## <z-disclosure> (components)
A disclosure (title → collapsible content) — inherits z-element states, accessible (aria-expanded/controls, inert when closed), animatable.
Attributes: open (boolean)
Events: toggle, z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success, open

## <z-alert> (components)
A contextual message — tone drives the colour, role=status (or alert for danger). Optionally dismissible.
Attributes: tone ("main" | "complement" | "soft" | "success" | "danger"), dismissible (boolean)
Events: zoe:dismiss, z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success

## <z-tooltip> (components)
A hint bubble shown on hover and keyboard focus — accessible via a [part=tip] piece wired with aria-describedby.
Attributes: tip (string), placement ("top" | "bottom")
Events: z-state
States :state(): default, over, press, release, releaseOut, drag, focus, enter, exit, current, select, unselect, loading, disabled, error, success
